info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Marketing Brand Managements-spec
info.description: The Marketing Brand Management Listing API provides access to a comprehensive list of marketing brands within the banking sector. This endpoint allows users to retrieve details about various brand management entities, facilitating insights into brand performance and visibility. It is particularly valuable for marketing teams, analysts, and business development professionals looking to enhance brand strategies and track brand assets. Developers can integrate this API into applications that require brand data visualization or reporting functionalities.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch information related to brand management, providing valuable insights into the marketing strategies employed for brand enhancement and visibility.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify parameters for the brand management operations. Ensure all required fields are filled correctly to retrieve the desired data.

200.description: Successful retrieval of brand management data.
